text:
Alex Chen: Quick pulse — where are we with the quickstarts for SDK v1.4? Changelog cutoff in ~4h. Can owners confirm PRs merged and sample apps green?
Samira Patel: @Alex Chen most SDK PRs merged. One remaining flaky test in sampleapp-auth (PR #842) failing CI, looking into it.
Jordan Lee: I'll grab the failing test. Reproduced locally, looks like async auth race. ETA ~2h.
Maria Gomez: Docs ready (auth snippet + migration notes). Waiting on package.json version bump and final changelog entry from @Samira.
Samira Patel: Adding changelog entry now, will push in 10m and tag reviewers.
CI Bot: build/sampleapp-auth — failure — pytest tests/test_login.py::test_timeout (trace: ConnectionTimeoutError)
Alex Chen: If CI green after that, can we cut the release branch? Need confirmation from @Jordan (tests) and @Maria (docs).
Jordan Lee: Rerun CI triggered: https://ci.redwood/2398765432/1 — I pushed a fix to debounce the auth call.
Maria Gomez: Docs PR updated with version field (1.4.0-rc.1) and sample config. Link: https://git.redwood/docs/pull/759
Samira Patel: Changelog added and approved by @Alex. Tagging in repo: https://git.redwood/changelog/entries/1.4.0-rc.1.md
CI Bot: build/sampleapp-auth — all checks passed ✅
Alex Chen: Sweet. Cutting release branch now. I'll create branch `release/sdk-1.4.0-rc1` and post notes to #eng-releases in ~15m.
Jordan Lee: I'll do a quick smoke in sandbox after branch cut and report back in 30m.
Maria Gomez: Did a manual smoke already against the RC build — auth flow + quickstart steps verified :thumbsup:
Samira Patel: Final ack from me. Tagging release notes and closing the ship checklist.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. If anything else pops up ping me or drop in this thread.
